title: Which country had the gas station that sold the most expensive product id N
question: Which country had the gas station that sold the most expensive product id No.2 for one unit?

auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
SELECT T2.Country
FROM transactions_1k AS T1
JOIN GasStationLocation AS T2 ON T1.GasStationID = T2.GasStationID
WHERE T1.ProductID = 2
ORDER BY T1.Price / T1.Amount DESC
LIMIT 1
